label: Defend or reject ultimate ground epistemic necessity for a concrete method/domain
locator: pp.9–13 and 18–21; compare Hume Enquiry IV.18–21 and V.2, V.21
goal: Defend or reject STMT-ULTIMATE-GROUND-EPISTEMIC-NECESSITY for a concrete method/domain. Identify which independently defended entitlement condition is lost when ultimate explanation is absent, while holding relevant local evidence, process performance and defeaters fixed. Compare internalist access, historical reliabilism and defeasible practice; no skepticism or theistic access by definition.
reason: The #737 nonempty stable and divergent-history controls prevent replacing this norm by law instability, nonuniqueness or payoff failure. Source witnesses offer positive accounts but no common ontic-to-epistemic necessity bridge. Adequate ultimate explanation itself remains disputed; the candidate is an open search, not attribution to Goldman. See docs/notes/ultimate-explanation-and-knowledge-737.md.
